entries.headline: ELDEN RING 'Tarnished Pack' Launches with 8 New Weapons and Shields
entries.summary: The 'Tarnished Pack' for ELDEN RING is now available on PC, PlayStation, and Xbox for ¥550. It includes two new origins—'Ithian Knight' and 'Heavy Knight'—three Spectral Steed skins, a new NPC invasion event, and eight additional weapons and shields. The Nintendo Switch 2 version, 'Tarnished Edition,' also launched the same day.

entries.headline: Otherworldly Exploration Horror Game '越え' Reveals Steam Page
entries.summary: Lunamarine Studio has unveiled the Steam page for '越え.' The game is a first-person, multiple-ending horror adventure where players investigate the disappearances of several paranormal-themed streamers in a village and hospital seemingly frozen in the 1970s, while trying to find a way back to reality. Only PC development has been confirmed so far.

entries.headline: Football Manager 27 Officially Announced, Planned for November Release
entries.summary: SEGA and Sports Interactive have officially announced Football Manager 27, planned for release in November 2026, with specific date and platforms to be revealed later. The team stated they will prioritize addressing UI feedback from the previous title, with features and gameplay footage to be unveiled starting in September. The Steam page has opened Playtest registration.

entries.headline: Caladrius2/Dark Element Set for December 10 Release
entries.summary: MOSS has announced that the 2D bullet-hell shooter Caladrius2/Dark Element will launch on December 10 for PS5, Nintendo Switch, and PC, with the digital version priced at ¥5,478. The game is a completely new entry in the Caladrius series, 13 years after the last installment, and retains the 'Shame Break' system where characters' appearances change upon taking damage.

entries.headline: UE5 'City Sample' Updated to 5.8, Adds PCG City Generation and Unreal MCP Support
entries.summary: Epic Games has updated the Unreal Engine 5 'City Sample' to UE 5.8, adding a level built with Procedural Content Generation tools and support for Unreal MCP. The project, derived from The Matrix Awakens tech demo, showcases large-scale maps, vehicles, crowds, and city-building workflows for developers.

entries.headline: Cassette Beasts 2002 Set for March 2027 Release
entries.summary: Raw Fury has announced that Bytten Studio's Cassette Beasts 2002 is planned for release in March 2027 on PC, PS5, Xbox Series, and Nintendo Switch 2. The sequel moves the setting to 2002 London and its otherworldly counterpart Nodnol, featuring over 250 monsters and more than 57,000 fusion forms.
